expectations.text: Identifies the root cause: Encoder dropped without finish(), so the frame epilogue is never written
expectations.evidence: States the encoder is dropped at Ok(()) and finish() is never called, so no end marker is written.

expectations.text: Fix calls encoder.finish()? and propagates the error
expectations.evidence: Corrected code calls encoder.finish()? then flushes the returned writer.

expectations.text: Correctly explains the small-vs-large size correlation via internal buffering/blocks
expectations.evidence: Explains small frames may still fit in buffers while large ones have flushed blocks and lose the final block+epilogue.

expectations.text: Notes the auto_finish() caveat (Drop-based finish swallows the error) on the save path
expectations.evidence: Explicitly warns against auto_finish() here because Drop can't return the finish Result.
